answer.rationale: P99 latency spike at 5x target arrived within 2 hours of a release during heavy write load. Memory b1 demonstrates rollback cleared a prior checkout error spike cleanly without customer impact, and memory b6 shows staged gating catches regressions early. The release is the most likely source given timing correlation. Verifying b1 confirms rollback is a safe, proven intervention here. We preserve write integrity (primary objective) and can measure impact before deciding next steps. Regional failover (b2) is valuable but doesn't address root cause; add_capacity takes time we don't have; circuit breakers (b4) risk dropping writes; read replica routing (b5) doesn't fix write path latency.
